title: OIL PRESSURE REGULATOR (For Lash Adjuster Valve)

content.description: Illustration showing the oil pressure regulator assembly installed on engine with timing belt cover area

content.text: REMOVAL AND DISASSEMBLY OF OIL PRESSURE REGULATOR

items: REMOVE OIL PRESSURE REGULATOR AND GASKET

DISASSEMBLE OIL PRESSURE REGULATOR ASSEMBLY
Unscrew the relief valve plug, and remove the spring and relief valve.

content.description: Exploded view diagram showing components of oil pressure regulator assembly including Relief Valve, Spring, Gasket, and Plug

content.text:
Check the relief valve for scoring or wear.
If damaged, replace the valve or regulator assembly.

content.description: Illustration showing hands inspecting the relief valve component

content.text: ASSEMBLY AND INSTALLATION OF OIL PRESSURE REGULATOR

items:
ASSEMBLE OIL PRESSURE REGULATOR ASSEMBLY
Install the relief valve and spring in the body, and screw on the relief valve plug
INSTALL OIL PRESSURE REGULATOR OVER NEW GASKET
START ENGINE AND CHECK FOR LEAKS

content.description: Illustration showing installation of oil pressure regulator assembly near timing belt cover
